auction-file-completeness.name: Auction File Completeness
auction-file-completeness.description: Compare their auction checklist to files in the folder. Mark missing. Completeness is not permission to sell.

late-list.name: Late List
late-list.description: From payment-status and their late export, list units coded past due. They contact occupants. You pack the list and fee-file asks.

move-in-packet-completeness.name: Move In Packet Completeness
move-in-packet-completeness.description: Check the agreement folder against their move-in checklist. They take payment and they issue access. You list present-or-missing.

occupancy.name: Occupancy
occupancy.description: Build the occupancy list from their rent-roll or occupancy export. They use the list. You write the pack and questions.

photo-condition-pack.name: Photo Condition Pack
photo-condition-pack.description: Index photos in the folder against occupancy or vacant units. They shoot and they mark ready. You write the index and missing-photo questions.

rate-from-file.name: Rate From File
rate-from-file.description: Tabulate street, web, in-place, and promo rates from the rate file they saved. They approve any number they will say. You do not send a rate letter.

transfer-list.name: Transfer List
transfer-list.description: List open unit transfers from their spreadsheet or occupancy notes. They approve the swap. You pack leftovers and missing agreements.

unit-mix.name: Unit Mix
unit-mix.description: From the unit-mix CSV, count units by size and climate versus standard as they coded them. They decide what to advertise. You list mix and questions.

waitlist.name: Waitlist
waitlist.description: List waitlist rows in their existing order with size wanted and date added. They call the next person. You write the list.
